The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.customer_id,
        co.pizza_id,
        co.order_time,
        co.exclusions,
        co.extras,
        pn.pizza_name,
        pr.toppings as standard_toppings
    FROM pizza_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON co.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    GROUP BY co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.pizza_id, co.order_time, co.exclusions, co.extras, pn.pizza_name, pr.toppings
),
standards AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        order_time,
        pizza_name,
        standard_toppings,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        string_to_array(standard_toppings, ', ') as std_ids
    FROM base
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        s.*,
        string_to_array(COALESCE(s.exclusions, ''), ',') as excl_ids,
        string_to_array(COALESCE(s.extras, ''), ',') as extra_ids
    FROM standards s
),
toppings_gen AS (
    SELECT 1 as topping_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        p.order_id,
        p.customer_id,
        p.pizza_id,
        p.order_time,
        p.pizza_name,
        p.std_ids,
        p.excl_ids,
        p.extra_ids,
        t.topping_id,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.std_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_std,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.excl_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_excl,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.extra_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_extra
    FROM parsed p
    CROSS JOIN toppings_gen t
),
with_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.*,
        GREATEST(0, e.in_std - e.in_excl + e.in_extra) as count
    FROM expanded e
),
final_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        wc.order_id,
        wc.customer_id,
        wc.pizza_id,
        wc.order_time,
        wc.pizza_name,
        wc.count,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM with_counts wc
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON wc.topping_id = pt.topping_id
    WHERE wc.count > 0
)
SELECT 
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_id,
    order_time,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name,
    count
FROM final_ingredients
GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_name, count

        order_time,
        pizza_name,
        standard_toppings,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        string_to_array(standard_toppings, ', ') as std_ids
    FROM base
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        s.*,
        string_to_array(COALESCE(s.exclusions, ''), ',') as excl_ids,
        string_to_array(COALESCE(s.extras, ''), ',') as extra_ids
    FROM standards s
),
toppings_gen AS (
    SELECT 1 as topping_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        p.order_id,
        p.customer_id,
        p.pizza_id,
        p.order_time,
        p.pizza_name,
        p.std_ids,
        p.excl_ids,
        p.extra_ids,
        t.topping_id,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.std_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_std,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.excl_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_excl,
        CASE WHEN CAST(t.topping_id AS VARCHAR) = ANY(p.extra_ids) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_extra
    FROM parsed p
    CROSS JOIN toppings_gen t
),
with_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.*,
        GREATEST(0, e.in_std - e.in_excl + e.in_extra) as count
    FROM expanded e
),
final_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        wc.order_id,
        wc.customer_id,
        wc.pizza_id,
        wc.order_time,
        wc.pizza_name,
        wc.count,
        pt.topping_name
    FROM with_counts wc
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON wc.topping_id = pt.topping_id
    WHERE wc.count > 0
)
SELECT 
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_id,
    order_time,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name,
    count
FROM final_ingredients
GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, topping_name, count
